_meta.name: Time Spent Reading
_meta.unit: minutes per day reading for personal interest, all people 15+
_meta.source: BLS American Time Use Survey (series TUU10101AA01006315)
_meta.note: BLS American Time Use Survey time-diary activity "reading for personal interest," civilians aged 15 and older, all days of the week. Diary coding, not a survey question, so there is no wording drift. 2020 was not published (COVID cut data collection) and is a real one-year hole. BLS publishes hours per day; stored here as minutes (×60, exact). Averaged over everyone — readers and non-readers alike (readers themselves average ~1.7 hours).
_meta.method: BLS public API v2, series TUU10101AA01006315 (avg hours/day, total population) × 60
